name: Sonia Gupta

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sonia Gupta combines a professional background in dentistry with writing, translation and literary editing in English, Hindi and Punjabi. Her publishing profile identifies Dera Bassi in Punjab as her home region. She compiled and edited Beauty: Beyond Appearance, a poetry anthology that brings together contributions exploring beauty beyond physical appearance.

Her two poems in Kabita Live offer contrasting forms of encouragement. “I WILL FIGHT BUT NOT QUIT” uses a woman’s determined first-person voice to meet setbacks with renewed resolve. “Whispers of Night” addresses the night as a living presence, drawing stars, fireflies, jasmine, readers and lullabies into a scene of shared rest and wonder.
